paragraphs: Status Solutions sells situational awareness technology covering life safety, environmental monitoring, security, and mass notification. The company describes those services as life safety assurance, real-time security monitoring and data analysis, environmental awareness, and mass notification technologies.

The solutions suite opens with SARA, called the pilot solution, an alarm manager that pulls siloed systems into one uniform alerting platform. CATIE is a communication platform for organizations such as schools and senior living communities, letting staff communicate with the people they are responsible for while tracking data that can inform safety decisions. MIMI is named as the platform for data analytics and advanced reporting across the available solutions. SAM is a security management platform that is hardware agnostic and includes security camera video management, recording, monitoring, and staff management tools.
Situational awareness technology solutions have been provided across the US and Canada. Headquarters is at 999 County Line Road W, Westerville, OH 43082.

quote.text: Not everyone has the same problems, we get that.
